name: Mara Venn

identity.backstory: Adult engineer working at a science-fiction spaceport repair facility.
continuity_rules: Keep Mara's facial proportions, eye shape and hairstyle consistent across references.
Keep costume colors and equipment consistent across all views.
Inspect head geometry in solid shading before painting.

appearance.silhouette: Realistic human proportions, A-pose, arms slightly away, feet fully visible.
appearance.face: Sharp distinctive face with one subtly arched eyebrow, visible eyelids, nose bridge, lips and jaw.
appearance.clothing: Fitted forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit, reinforced seams, work gloves, dark industrial boots.
appearance.equipment: Practical utility belt with small repair-tool attachments; no handheld props.

prompts.master: Full-body character reference for a stylized science-fiction video game NPC, Mara Venn, an adult human female repair engineer working at a spaceport repair facility. She has a sharp, distinctive face, chestnut-brown hair neatly tied back, a slightly raised chin and one subtly arched eyebrow. Her expression is confident, aloof, snobbish and faintly unimpressed, as if she's the smartest technician in the room. Keep her attractive but believable, capable and clearly recognizable, with realistic human proportions and a memorable silhouette. She wears a fitted, functional forest-green and charcoal-gray engineering jumpsuit with restrained metallic details, reinforced seams, practical utility belt, subtle repair-tool attachments, work gloves and sturdy dark industrial boots. Her clothes show mild signs of working around spacecraft, but she is unusually meticulous and tidy. No helmet, no bulky backpack, no tools held in her hands. Character is standing upright in a relaxed A-pose, arms slightly away from the torso, hands open and visible, legs separated slightly, feet fully visible. Entire character in frame from top of head to soles of boots, generous margins on all sides. Single character only, front three-quarter view, camera at chest height, accurate anatomy and symmetrical limbs. Soft even studio lighting, clean light-gray seamless background, no ground props, no scenery, no shadows obscuring the feet. High-quality stylized realistic 3D game character concept art, clearly separated clothing materials, crisp facial features and costume details, suitable as a reference image for image-to-3D mesh reconstruction.
prompts.negative: No text, no labels, no watermark, no collage, no extra people, no cropped body parts, no additional limbs or fingers, no exaggerated caricature, no dramatic action pose, no kiosk.

reference_views.front: Neutral front view with upright A-pose and all body parts fully visible.
reference_views.three_quarter: Slight three-quarter view showing face, outfit and silhouette without occlusion.
reference_views.side: Clean orthographic side view with identical face and hairstyle.
reference_views.back: Straight back view consistent with other references.
reference_views.head_closeup: Same Mara Venn identity: head and neck, nearly front facing, eyes and eyelids clearly defined, sharp nose bridge, visible lips and jaw, even neutral lighting, both ears and full hairline visible.

parts.label: Body / primary silhouette

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct a full-body A-pose with coherent proportions and practical sci-fi outfit silhouette.

quality_gates: Inspect the original shape before any reduction
parts.notes: Keep the main body independent of experiments on smaller parts.

parts.label: Head and face

prompts.geometry: Reconstruct isolated head-and-neck geometry with clearly shaped eye sockets, eyelids, nose, lips, ears, and jaw while preserving Mara's identity.
prompts.texture: Natural skin, consistent eye shape, facial expression, and hairline; no hair texture bleeding across the eyes.

quality_gates: Eyes and eyelids readable in solid shading
Nose, mouth, ears and jaw clearly formed
Inspect front and profile geometry before texture painting
parts.notes: Generate separately when full-body reconstruction loses facial anatomy.

parts.label: Hair / head covering

prompts.geometry: Chestnut-brown hair pulled back, with clean hairline and consistent silhouette.

parts.notes: Region or separate mesh: choose during implementation.

parts.label: Clothing and surface materials

prompts.texture: Forest-green and charcoal engineering jumpsuit, practical seams, reinforced details, modest wear.

quality_gates: Textures do not bleed across UV islands
parts.notes: A region need not be a separate mesh.

parts.label: Hands / gloves
quality_gates: Finger count and joint silhouettes are plausible
parts.notes: Can later become an independent mesh if needed.

parts.label: Equipment / accessories

prompts.geometry: Separate small tool pouches and equipment attached at the belt, no handheld items.

quality_gates: Accessories do not intersect the body unexpectedly
parts.notes: Add or remove accessories as needed; parent and attachment are descriptive for now.

assembly.notes: Head-to-neck alignment is not yet automated. Approval of components precedes assembly.
